values.note: $8 per site per night (2026 and 2027 peak-season rate on recreation.gov).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/east-lake-campsites ('Overnight Use: Single Site: $8 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/273346/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 - 2026-10-15 and 2027: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $8), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reservation only, no walk-ins, May 15 - Columbus Day (recreation.gov or 877-444-6777); same-day booking allowed. The campsite must be occupied the first night and not left unattended more than 24 hours. Run by the Forest Service (not a concession).

values.note: Three primitive sites on different shores. Site 1 (40 ft, 100 x 75 ft, up to three families) is on a wooded hill above the west shore off FR 2650, the drivable choice for a 23-ft motorhome. Site 2 (24 ft) is reached by a narrow, winding road that 'can be traversed by small trailers'; site 3 (24 ft, on a point with the best swimming) has 'very narrow and winding access road' where trailers are NOT recommended. All three are listed pull-through.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/273346 (Natural Features: site sizes and access-road warnings; 'Number of Sites : 3') + RIDB catalog for facility 273346 (Max Vehicle Length 40 / 24 / 24, Driveway Entry Pull-Through on all three), read 2026-10-25

note: Three primitive Forest Service campsites on 53-acre East Lake, Hiawatha NF (Rapid River/Manistique district), off M-94 about 22 miles north of Manistique; supplies at Steuben, two miles northwest. Unimproved, shallow, sandy back-in boat access just past site 1 (carry-in recommended). Largemouth bass, perch, bluegill and bullheads, swimming and berry picking. Pack in, pack out. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: $8 a night (confirmed, 2026/2027), reservation only on recreation.gov with no walk-ins (fcfs never, url, 14-night max, new), season of use May 15 - Columbus Day (season note new), no water or electric (confirmed), 3 pull-through sites to 40 ft (confirmed). A 23-ft motorhome fits site 1 (40 ft, wooded hill on the west shore off FR 2650); site 2's road is narrow and winding but takes small trailers, and trailers are NOT recommended at site 3. Toilets left unset: recreation.gov says 'primitive toilets located at sites 1 and 2', the FS page says 'Restrooms are not available'. Operated by the Forest Service; phone 906-474-6442 matches. No forest alert or order names East Lake or its forest roads. Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Website is the recreation.gov listing only; the Forest Service's own page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/east-lake-campsites.

Access: recreation.gov warns site 3's 'very narrow and winding access road' makes it unsuitable for trailers and calls site 2's road 'narrow and winding'; only site 1 (40 ft) is plainly drivable for a 23-ft motorhome.
